# Apex Conclave

> Apex Conclave is a youth-led events ecosystem in India. It runs conferences, simulations and competitions where high school and college students practise diplomacy, enterprise and policy. Diplovia 2026, a virtual Model United Nations, is its first event.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what Apex Conclave is, its events, team and network
- [Events](/events): every event, upcoming and past
- [Diplovia 2026](/events/diplovia-2026): virtual MUN with five committees (UNSC, WHO, UNHRC, UNGA, Historical Crisis Committee); fees, allotment and FAQ
- [About](/about): mission and team
- [Community](/community): delegates, speakers, volunteers
- [Partners](/partners): partnership options
- [FAQ](/faq) and [Contact](/contact)
